clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Dazalar trains young night elf hunters for the wilds of Teldrassil. He teaches them to aim true and form bonds with the beasts of the great boughs.

Dazalar trains young hunters in Dolanaar before they venture beyond Shadowglen. Night elf rangers and sentinels patrol the wilderness, and he teaches newcomers the patience and discipline needed to protect Teldrassil's fragile ecosystem.

Dazalar teaches hunters to tame and care for beasts. The Kaldorei seek a pact with forest predators such as nightsabers, owls, and strigid hunters, training them to fight beside their companions with respect rather than force.
